--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+# backup_rotate.py
+
+`backup_rotate.py` is a tool for creating timestamped archives of a directory and managing them through a retention policy or age-s-based pruning.
+
+## Usage
+
+```bash
+python3 backup_rotate.py [COMMAND] [ARGS]
+```
+
+### Global Options
+
+| Option | Description | Default |
+| :--- | :--- | :--- |
+| `-v`, `--verbose` | Log each file considered to stderr | `False` |
+| `--version` | Print version and exit | - |
+
+## Commands
+
+### `create`
+
+Archives a directory into the backup directory.
+
+**Arguments:**
+
+| Argument | Description |
+| :--- | :--- |
+| `source` | The directory to archive |
+
+**Options:**
+
+| Option | Description | Default |
+| :--- | :--- | :--- |
+| `-d`, `--backup-dir` | Directory that holds the archives (can be set via `BACKUP_ROTATE_DIR` env var) | `"backups"` |
+| `--prefix` | Archive name prefix; archives with other prefixes are never touched | `"backup"` |
+| `--format` | Archive format (`tar.gz` or `zip`) | `"tar.gz"` |
+| `--exclude` | Glob matched against relative paths and each path component (repeatable) | `[]` |
+
+**Example:**
+
+```bash
+python3 backup_rotate.py create my_project -d my_backups --format zip
+```
+
+---
+
+### `plan`
+
+Shows which archives the retention policy keeps.
+
+**Options:**
+
+| Option | Description | Default |
+| :--- | :--- | :--- |
+| `-d`, `--backup-dir` | Directory that holds the archives (can be set via `BACKUP_ROTATE_DIR` env var) | `"backups"` |
+| `--prefix` | Archive name prefix; archives with other prefixes are never touched | `"backup"` |
+| `--keep-daily` | Keep the newest archive of each of the last N days | `7` |
+| `--keep-weekly` | Keep the newest archive of each of the last N ISO weeks | `4` |
+| `--keep-monthly` | Keep the newest archive of each of the last N calendar months | `12` |
+| `--json` | Print the plan as JSON | `False` |
+
+**Example:**
+
+```bash
+python3 backup_rotate.py plan -d my_backups --prefix backup --keep-daily 7
+```
+
+---
+
+### `apply`
+
+Removes archives that the retention policy drops.
+
+**Options:**
+
+| Option | Description | Default |
+| :--- | :--- | :--- |
+| `-d`, `--backup-dir` | Directory that holds the archives (can be set via `BACKUP_ROTATE_DIR` env var) | `"backups"` |
+| `--prefix` | Archive name prefix; archives with other prefixes are never touched | `"backup"` |
+| `--keep-daily` | Keep the newest archive of each of the last N days | `7` |
+| `--keep-weekly` | Keep the newest archive of each of the last N ISO weeks | `4` |
+| `--keep-monthly` | Keep the newest archive of each of the last N calendar months | `12` |
+| `-n`, `--dry-run` | Only print what would be removed | `False` |
+| `--trash` | Move archives into `DIR/.trash/` instead of deleting them | `False` |
+
+**Example:**
+
+```bash
+python3 backup_rotate.py apply -d my_backups --trash
+```
+
+---
+
+### `prune`
+
+Removes archives older than a specified cutoff.
+
+**Options:**
+
+| Option | Description | Default |
+| :--- | :--- | :--- |
+| `-d`, `--backup-dir` | Directory that holds the archives (can be set via `BACKUP_ROTATE_DIR` env var) | `"backups"` |
+| `--prefix` | Archive name prefix; archives with other prefixes are never touched | `"backup"` |
+| `--max-age` | Remove archives older than N days | `90` |
+| `--min-keep` | Never remove the newest N archives, however old | `3` |
+| `-n`, `--dry-run` | Only print what would be removed | `False` |
+
+**Example:**
+
+```bash
+python3 backup_rotate.py prune -d my_backups --max-age 30 --dry-run
+```
